title: 第二十三章 围杀贺第五盟殊胜天下第二十四章 苏莜的改变
content_zh:
（感谢殊胜天下三十万飘红，成为天下第九的第五盟主，盟主威武！）
虽然没有发现什么，狄九也准备走了。还没等他走出座位，大厅中忽然暗了下来。
“停电了！”有人叫了出来。
大家都很是疑惑，按理说彼岸会所这种顶级会所，是绝对不会发生停电这种事情的。就算是停电，也有备用电路。
有些人已经打开了手机电筒，一名会所的守卫出现在门口大声叫道，“会所电路出现了故障，请所有人立刻离场。”
苏莜的父亲脸色很难看，就是来的客人都觉得不可思议。不过没有人责问，传闻彼岸会所背后的能量很大，如果没有必要，没有人愿意和彼岸会所闹僵。
“各位朋友，今天实在是对不起了……”苏敏羽只能向众多的宾客道歉。
狄九却肯定这不是寻常的停电事件，之前他刚刚感受到有些不妥，就好像有人盯着他一样，转眼就发生了停电时间，这十有八九是针对他的。
看样子时锦姗说的没错，彼河大厦就是太平擂台的老巢。只是让狄九不明白的是，彼河大厦的那个彼郑生怎么知道他杀了那个家伙？
狄九一弯腰，将绑腿上的匕首收进袖口，没有和任何人打招呼，直接跨出了会所的大门。
果然和他预料的一样，他一走出会所大门，立即就再次感受到了有人跟踪。
看样子不会在会所动手，之所以停电，是想要等他离开会所后动手。狄九冷静下来，他不知道彼郑生的实力，他肯定以他现在的实力想要对付彼郑生，还差的太远。
带着戒备，狄九从楼梯一直下到一楼，直到他走出彼河大厦广场后，依然没有人动手。但是那跟踪的感觉，是越来越清晰。
狄九加快了速度，大约过了十多分钟，在他刚刚走到一条略偏的路段，一辆黑色的轿车就直接从后面冲了过来，将他的去路拦住。
跟着车上下来了四个人，四人分工极为明确，直接将狄九前后路全部封死。
“是彼郑生叫你们来的？”狄九看着眼前这四个人，语气极为平静。
为首的是一名有着一头波浪长发的男子，脸型很是分明，在他的身上带着一种若有若无的凌厉杀意。他听到狄九的话，略讶异的看了一眼狄九，这才说道，“难怪敢去埋何山，就凭借你这份镇定，只要你能和我们走一趟，说不定生爷还会留你一命。否则的话，你很快就会成为下一个失踪人。”
在这波浪发男子看来，狄九还没有能力去杀何山。狄九去埋葬何山，应该只是一个跑腿的家伙而已。
“呵呵，我今天刚去彼岸会所就失踪。”狄九讥讽了一句。
波浪长发男子淡淡的说道，“谁说你今天失踪呢？你明天还会出现，甚至再过几天你还会和一个漂亮的小妞一起单独离开洛津。对了，那小妞你今天还见过哦。”

狄九已经明白过来，这些人手段老道，肯定有的是办法。他一边估摸着这几个人的实力，如果打不过他应该往那边逃，一边手段，“回答我一个问题，也许我会和你走一趟。”
“找死……”站在狄九身后一名健壮男子拔出开山刀一步跨前，手中的开山刀就劈向了狄九。
“大炉，现在不要弄伤……”波浪长发男子显然是头，只是他这句话还没说完，就看见狄九身体转了半个圈，抬起了脚。
狄九居然敢还手，波浪发男子再也顾不得让手下留情，自己也抓起开山刀劈向了狄九。
content_en:
(Thanks to the 300,000 Piaohong from the Supreme World, I became the fifth leader of the ninth alliance in the world. The leader is mighty!)
Although he didn't find anything, Di Jiu was ready to leave. Before he could get out of his seat, the hall suddenly became dark.
"Power outage!" someone shouted.
Everyone is very confused. It stands to reason that a power outage will never happen in a top club like Bian'an Club. Even if there is a power outage, there is a backup circuit.
Some people had already turned on their mobile phone flashlights, and a club guard appeared at the door and shouted, "There is a circuit failure in the club. Please leave everyone immediately."
Su You's father looked so ugly that even the guests found it incredible. However, no one blamed it. It was rumored that there was a lot of energy behind the Bian'an Club, and no one was willing to have a quarrel with the Bian'an Club if it was not necessary.
"Dear friends, I'm really sorry today..." Su Minyu could only apologize to the many guests.
Di Jiu was certain that this was not an ordinary power outage. He had just felt something was wrong, as if someone was staring at him, and in the blink of an eye, the power outage occurred. This was most likely aimed at him.
It seemed that Shi Jinshan was right, Bihe Building was the home of Taiping Arena. What Di Jiu didn't understand was how did Zhengsheng from Bihe Building know that he had killed that guy?
Di Jiuyi bent down, put the dagger on his leggings into his cuffs, and walked out of the club door without saying hello to anyone.
Just as he expected, as soon as he walked out of the club door, he immediately felt someone following him again.
It seems that he will not take action in the club. The reason for the blackout is to wait for him to leave the club before taking action. Di Jiu calmed down. He didn't know Bi Zhengsheng's strength. He must be too far behind to deal with Bi Zhengsheng with his current strength.
With caution, Di Jiu went down the stairs to the first floor. No one made a move until he walked out of the square of Bihe Building. But the feeling of tracking is getting clearer and clearer.
Di Jiu sped up. About ten minutes later, just as he reached a slightly off-road section, a black car rushed over from behind and blocked his way.
Four people got out of the car. Their division of labor was very clear, and they blocked Di Jiu's front and back roads.
"Did Zheng Sheng ask you to come here?" Di Jiu looked at the four people in front of him with an extremely calm tone.
The leader was a man with long, wavy hair. His face was very distinct, and he had a vague and fierce murderous intention on his body. Hearing Di Jiu's words, he glanced at Di Jiu in surprise, and then said, "No wonder you dare to bury He Shan. With your calmness, as long as you can come with us, maybe Mr. Sheng will spare your life. Otherwise, you will soon become the next missing person."
In the view of the wavy-haired man, Di Jiu was not yet capable of killing He Shan. Di Jiu went to bury He Shan. He was probably just an errand boy.
"Haha, I disappeared just after I went to the Bian'an Club today." Di Jiu said sarcastically.
The wavy-haired man said calmly, "Who said you disappeared today? You will show up tomorrow, and even in a few days you will leave Luojin alone with a beautiful girl. By the way, you have seen that girl today."
Di Jiu has understood that these people are sophisticated and must have many solutions. While he assessed the strength of these people, if he couldn't defeat them, which way he should flee, he said, "Answer me a question, maybe I will go with you."
"Looking for death..." A strong man standing behind Di Jiu pulled out a machete and stepped forward. The machete in his hand struck Di Jiu.
"Big furnace, don't get hurt now..." The man with wavy hair was obviously his head, but before he could finish his sentence, he saw Di Jiu turning half a circle and raising his feet.
Di Jiu actually dared to fight back. The wavy-haired man could no longer care.Asking his subordinates to be merciful, he also grabbed the machete and struck Di Jiu.
